description: Passes an audio signal to six outputs, each one open only while the logic condition it is named for holds between the two logic inputs

inputs.text: One of the two logic inputs; it counts as high only at exactly 10V, and every other voltage counts as low
The signal the six outputs carry; each output whose condition holds carries whatever is here, and every other output carries 0V

outputs.text: Carries the audio input while both A and B are at exactly 10V, and 0V otherwise
Carries the audio input while either A or B is at exactly 10V, and 0V while neither is
Carries the audio input while exactly one of A and B is at exactly 10V, and 0V otherwise
Carries the audio input unless both A and B are at exactly 10V, and 0V while both are
Carries the audio input while neither A nor B is at exactly 10V, and 0V while either one is
Carries the audio input while A and B agree, either both at exactly 10V or both away from it, and 0V while they differ

notes: A and B read high only at exactly 10V. A 5V gate, or a 10V gate that an attenuator has touched at all, counts as low and opens nothing.
each output fades in and out over 12 samples when its condition changes, so a gate does not click.
with nothing patched into Audio in, every open output carries 0V, so the module makes no sound of its own.
the two lamps beside the jacks light while A and while B are at 10V, and the green lamp in the logic drawing lights while A and B differ.
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and each output carries one channel.
